knownQuirks: [
  "Service Account approach preferred over user OAuth for MuleSoft server-to-server — eliminates user token rotation issues",
  "Spreadsheet ID (from the URL between /d/ and /edit) and Sheet tab name must be stable in connector config — any rename breaks the integration",
  "Column headers must be a single flat row — merged cells or multi-row headers must be normalized before DataWeave mapping",
  "Connector returns rows as arrays indexed by position — DataWeave must map positional columns to named fields using header row as key",
  "Rate limits: 300 reads/min and 60 writes/min per Google Cloud project — not a concern at typical polling frequencies",
  "Sheet must be shared with the Service Account email (Editor access minimum) before the connector can read it",
  "If spreadsheet is in a Shared Drive (Team Drive), Service Account needs domain-wide delegation or Drive API access enabled"
]

supportedObjects: [
  "Spreadsheet ranges (A1 notation)",
  "Named ranges",
  "Sheet metadata",
  "Row append / update / delete"
]
